findings.note: Bayshore Elementary School District Governing Board, at-large SHORT term (2-yr unexpired). The office IS scheduled for Nov 3 2026 per the county Candidate Guide ('Bayshore Elementary School District, Governing Board (Short Term) — Seats up: 2'). It is completely ABSENT from the Registrar's 'Roster of Candidates — Qualified Candidates Only' printed 9/3/2026 2:10 PM (the only candidate roster on the county's Nov 3 2026 election page as of retrieval; Wayback confirms the same file still linked Oct 5-9, 2026). The Full Term contest appears in that roster (contest code 3400, 'Vote for 3', On Ballot: No, 3 qualified) — so the Short Term row's absence means zero qualified candidates on the Sept 3 certified extract, not a print omission. Note: the county's extended-filing list (updated 8/12/26) extended filing for Bayshore ESD Full Term but NOT the Short Term seat. Absence from the roster is strong evidence no candidate qualified, which in CA practice leads to election cancellation / appointment-in-lieu — but NO adopted cancellation resolution or appointment record was located before research was cut off, and no later 'final ballot' list has been published by the county. Per project evidence standard this stays unresolved: not_on_ballot cannot be asserted on roster absence alone. FOLLOW-UP LEADS: (1) smcacre.gov /elections/candidates-and-measures and /elections/november-3-2026-statewide-general-election for any post-Sept roster or ballot proof; (2) Bayshore ESD board agendas/minutes Sept-Oct 2026 (bayshoreesd.org) for a cancellation resolution or vacancy appointment; (3) re-pull the roster PDF — if a new dated roster appears, check it before determining.

findings.note: Colma Fire Protection District Director, at-large (4-yr, 1 seat). The office IS scheduled for Nov 3 2026 per the county Candidate Guide ('Colma Fire Protection District, Board of Directors — Seats up: 1') and its filing period was EXTENDED to Aug 12, 2026 (extension occurs when an eligible incumbent does not file). Despite that, NO Colma Fire Protection District contest appears anywhere in the Registrar's 9/3/2026 Qualified Candidates roster (regex 'Colma Fire' = zero hits; only Town of Colma City Council, code 5081, appears — a different office). Zero qualified candidates as of the Sept 3 certified extract. As with CA2026-302, no adopted cancellation resolution or appointment record was located before research was cut off, and the county has published no later final candidate list; per evidence standard this stays unresolved rather than not_on_ballot. FOLLOW-UP LEADS: (1) Colma Fire Protection District commission/board minutes Aug-Oct 2026 (colmafire.org/commissioners/ — inventory source S400) for appointment-in-lieu or cancellation; (2) smcacre.gov Nov 3 election page + Wayback for any post-Sept roster/ballot proof; (3) Town of Colma clerk / county clerk records of vacancy filling under Elections Code 1050 et seq.

limitations: Research was terminated early on 2026-10-13 by an operator stop order (GPU concurrency limit); district-board minutes for Bayshore ESD and Colma Fire PD were NOT checked, so no adopted cancellation/appointment resolution could be confirmed or ruled out.

The San Mateo County Registrar publishes a single 'Roster of Candidates' report; no separately titled 'final certified candidate list' or online ballot proof was found for Nov 3 2026 as of retrieval. The 9/3/2026 roster is the latest candidate list on the county's election page (still current per Wayback captures through Oct 9, 2026), but it predates the Sept 25 ballot-certification window, so a later updated roster may exist and was not located.

The 'On Ballot: Yes/No' column in the CFMR009 roster report is interpreted as whether the contest appears printed on the ballot (e.g., Bayshore Full Term: 3 qualified for 3 seats -> On Ballot: No); this interpretation is inferred from the data pattern, not from a published registrar legend.
Candidate Guide lists 'Seats up: 2' for the Bayshore ESD Short Term office while inventory CA2026-302 records 1 seat; discrepancy noted, unresolved.
